rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the feeling or experience of being astonished.

example.traditional: 大家都睇得出我嘅驚訝。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 ngo5 ge3 ging1 ngaa6

rows.note: Use this when the astonishment is especially shocking or has a strong public impact.

example.english: This scandal caused astonishment throughout the city.
example.traditional: 呢宗醜聞引起全城震驚。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 cau2 man4 jan5 hei2 cyun4 sing4 zan3 ging1
